pages.heading: Cold Sweat insulation
pages.body: Worn pack default: 3 cold / 1 heat insulation. Built-in insulation uses sewing capacity. Read the live item tooltip before adding linings; server settings take precedence.

pages.heading: Aether Altar repair
pages.body: Pack defaults: Repair this damaged item in an Aether Altar in 35 seconds with normal altar fuel. Its name, enchantments and sewn insulation are retained. See $(l:patchouli:chapters/aether#kncraft_altar_repairs)altar maintenance$(/l).
